name: What are the first steps to placing a tiny home on my land?

step.name: Step 1: Get a Site Feasibility Consultation — This is crucial. Before doing anything else, you'll want an expert to check out your property. Zen Tiny Homes has a Site Plan Program that covers everything from land use planning and zoning to topography and utility access. We’ll assess things like drainage, power, water supply, and the best foundation setup for your tiny home. This initial assessment helps us understand what’s possible on your specific plot and identify any potential hurdles early on.

step.name: Step 2: Understand Local Regulations and Zoning — Tiny homes, whether they're ADUs on a foundation or mobile units, have different rules. Zen Tiny Homes has spent years working with local agencies in Southern California, so we can help you navigate the specific zoning and code requirements in your area. This includes understanding setbacks, occupancy limits, and necessary permits. It’s all about ensuring your tiny home is placed legally and efficiently.

step.name: Step 3: Develop a Custom Design — Once you know what your land can support, it's time for the fun part: designing your home! Our 3D Design Program works one-on-one with you to create a unique floor plan. We’ll cover arrangements, digital sketching, blueprints, and architectural services, all tailored to how you live. This design phase ensures your home is not just small, but also high-functioning and personal.

step.name: Step 4: Budget and Financing — After the design is finalized, we'll use it to price out your build. Understanding the total cost, including site prep and utility hookups, is vital. We aim to make quality tiny living accessible without sacrificing craftsmanship. We can discuss financing options and help you understand the overall investment.

step.name: Step 5: Construction Prep and Build — With plans approved and funding in place, we move to ordering materials and preparing your site. Our typical build timeline is around 90 days for our pre-designed homes, though custom projects might take a bit longer. We work closely with you through the entire construction process, from the foundation to the final touches, making sure your tiny home comes to life exactly as you envisioned. Following these steps ensures a smooth journey to your new tiny home!
